blocking_failures: deterministic_tests: The functional data generation is seeded, but test_large_database_budget_and_equivalence asserts elapsed < 12 using time.monotonic(), so ordinary host load or scheduling variation can change the result independently of correctness.

valid_failure_modes: The wall-clock performance assertion introduces an environment-dependent failure mode on a one-CPU container, allowing a correct implementation to fail due to host contention or runtime variance rather than task behavior.
advice: test_deps_in_image: The Dockerfile installs pytest==8.3.4 in the runtime image even though pytest is a test-only dependency; tests/test.sh separately provisions its own isolated pytest environment.

oracle_investigates: solution/solve.sh unconditionally writes a preconstructed query.py via a heredoc and does not inspect the repository, schema, migration history, callers, or instruction to derive the change.
